input.prompt: The FIRST image shows the body position to copy; the other images define the person and the photo style. Black-and-white studio instruction photo for a home-gym exercise manual, in exactly the style of the reference photos: the same man (short dark hair, clean-shaven, black sleeveless shirt, grey athletic shorts, white running shoes), plain light-grey seamless backdrop and light-grey floor, soft even studio lighting, slightly grainy monochrome print look, full body visible, nothing cropped, portrait format. No text, no watermark, no border, no logos, no mat.
